description.content: The Meter Exemptions API enables registered Metering Coordinators (MCs) to create and manage metering exemptions within MSATS.

Get meter exemption details for a specified meter exemption, including:
- Participant contact details - Meter exemption details - Meter exemption history - Meter exemption NMI list. If the NMI is not specified: - In the csv file, it returns the whole NMI list. - In json format, it returns up to 1000 NMIs.

query.description: The NMI to retrieve. The NMI must be part of the Meter Exemption

description.content:
Returns a list of meter exemptions based on the query parameters.The response format is defined in the Accept header.
When the content type is:
- application/json, up to 1000 meter exemptions records are returned
- text/csv, up to 75,000 meter exemption records are returned

query.description: Retrieves a list of meter exemptions for a given status. There are two status values, one for exemptions and one for NMIs. Must be one of ACTIVE, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, MOREINFO, REJECTED, RESOLVED, REVIEW
The meter exemption for the given ID
The meter exemptions list from a given date. Format YYYY-MM-DD
The meter exemptions list to a given date. Format YYYY-MM-DD
Returns meter exemptions for the given NMI
